'''Scott Gaeta''' was the editor and publisher of [[Game Players Network]] (GPN), the fan gaming site that hosted the ''Star Wars'' CCG [[Players Committee]] in its first year.<ref name="about">[https://web.archive.org/web/20041011081657/http://www.gameplayersnetwork.com/about/default.asp About GPN], gameplayersnetwork.com (Wayback, 11 October 2004)</ref>

== Game Players Network and the Players Committee ==
On 25 January 2002 Gaeta posted on GPN's news desk that [[Warren Holland]] had named the six core Player Advocates and that GPN's offer to support the committee had been accepted.<ref name="news">[https://web.archive.org/web/20041012153722/http://www.gameplayersnetwork.com/card/news.asp?gm=starwars News Archives], gameplayersnetwork.com (Wayback, 12 October 2004)</ref>

The same day he appeared on ''[[Radio Free Decipher]]'' Broadcast 112, having flown in from Denver. He said GPN had volunteered after Decipher's call for Players Committee volunteers, and that its 40 to 50 volunteers would give the committee web space, interviews and support for its tournament formats, a message board for player suggestions, and the web programming for posting virtual-card text on decipher.com.<ref>[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=docK2vpQWUI&t=678s Broadcast 112 - Radio Free Decipher (25 January, 2002): Scott Gaeta on the SWCCG PC], Player's Council, YouTube (uploaded 13 May 2022), at 11:18. Preserved copy: [https://archive.org/details/youtube-docK2vpQWUI Internet Archive]. Transcript: [[Radio Free Decipher/Episode 112 transcript]].</ref> He described [[Michael Girard]] as one of GPN's roving tournament reporters and [[John Arendt]], a fellow Coloradan, as one of the most underrated players in the world.<ref>[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=docK2vpQWUI&t=874s Broadcast 112 - Radio Free Decipher (25 January, 2002): Scott Gaeta on the SWCCG PC], Player's Council, YouTube (uploaded 13 May 2022), at 14:34. Preserved copy: [https://archive.org/details/youtube-docK2vpQWUI Internet Archive]. Transcript: [[Radio Free Decipher/Episode 112 transcript]].</ref>
